text:
Anya: Quick kickoff — next-week PLG push. Goals: 3 launch posts, a 45-min webinar, and a seeded starter-credit experiment. Need headlines, a short benchmark narrative for the blog post, prompt templates for onboarding email, and an inbound routing matrix. Who owns creative?
Mike: I can own headlines + email drip wire. planning A/B headlines and a CTA test.
Sam: Creative can do social + blog hero. voice question — hardcore dev utility or product-story orientation?
Anya: Prioritize dev-utility but include one enterprise angle line. headlines to test: performance-first vs time-to-value.
Olivia: I'll pull last-30d baseline metrics (activation rate, avg tokens/session, cost/token) and sketch the benchmark narrative. sending sheet link when done.
Mike: Credit experiment idea: 300 starter credits, 7-day expiry. Email at day0 (welcome + 3 prompts) and day3 (usage tips). track "credit_redeemed" via Segment. If a new account redeems >10k tokens in 7d, flag as "warm" for SDR routing.
Sam: I'll build a 6-prompt pack and pick top 3 for the day0 email. Tentative prompts: onboarding assistant, code reviewer, test-case generator, cold-email writer, product-idea stim, meeting-notes extractor.
Mike: Sample inline snippet for email (simple copy):
```
Use these three prompts today:
1) "Summarize this PR in 3 bullets"
2) "Generate unit tests for function X"
3) "Refactor this snippet to async/await"
```
Anya: Love that. Make the CTA: "Try 3 prompts" instead of a generic "Get started".
Olivia: Benchmark narrative quick take: if starter cohort converts at 18-25% with prompts vs baseline 10-12%, that's a strong story. I'll add a conservative CI and put numbers in the doc. link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-sheet-for-team (will replace with real link)
Sam: Creative asks: need hero image 1200x628, 2 copy variants (A/B), and one stat callout. Can we lock the stat by Wednesday so assets use the right number?
Anya: We'll call out a single conservative stat phrased as "Early testers saw ~X% more activations" and avoid absolute claims. Olivia, can you pin a number by EOD Wed?
Olivia: Yes, I'll have the table and the recommended stat by EOD Wed.
MarketingBot: Webinar scheduled Thu 11:00am — RSVP form created: https://cal.example/webinar-launch (auto-created)
Mike: For inbound routing matrix: rule proposal — if credit_redeemed AND total_tokens_7d > 10k => tag "warm" and route to sales-new queue; if total_tokens_7d between 1k-10k => nurture via Growth. We'll implement via Zapier -> internal routing playbook.
Sam: For social copy, lean technical: include a short code example or results snippet. Design will prefer a clean, devy aesthetic.
Jake: I'll drop hero + two variants (dev-utility / enterprise line) by EOD tomorrow. working on 1200x628 + mobile crop.
Mike: Timeline check: drafts by EOD tomorrow, A/B set up in Launch board, webinar Thu, posts schedule Fri morning. Email drip ready for send right after webinar recording.
Anya: Assignments: Mike = headlines + email drip; Sam = creative + prompt pack; Olivia = metrics + benchmark narrative; Jake = hero variants; Anya = routing + overall launch orchestration. Ping me if blocked.
Sam: One ask — can we include a short demo prompt in the webinar that shows latency + cost comparison? gives cred to the benchmark.
Olivia: I can prepare a 2-slide benchmark: latency, avg cost/token, and expected uplift.
Anya: Perfect. Keep copy tight: emphasize "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" and the activation lift.
Mike: Noted. I'll include that line in headline B.
Anya: :thumbsup: Thanks all — we'll sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize assets.
Jake: will be there.
MarketingBot: Reminder set for tomorrow 10:30.
Anya: Closing notes — small rollout first: seed 300 credits to 500 accounts, monitor activation and support load, then scale.
Mike: A/B headlines list and email wire link: https://notion.example/launch-draft (will update).
Olivia: Shared preliminary numbers in the sheet.
Sam: I'll post first creative drafts in #design-review channel when ready.
Anya: Great. End of thread.
